summary: Review pass 2. All seven pass-1 findings are resolved in code, tests and docs. AdminPaymentsExport escapes user-supplied name, e-mail, currency and description against spreadsheet formula injection (EscapesFormulaInjection trait, test with HYPERLINK, + and @ payloads, docs section 8 corrected). WalletDTO::forUpdate() lets explicit nulls clear the five optional wallet fields on web and API while omitted fields keep their value; this matches the store rules, OpenAPI WalletUpdateInput and docs/api/phase-5-api.md. TransactionMonthFilterTest pins four month-ends. AdminAccessTest runs the full persona matrix against every resource index and view URL. AdminUserService::promote() shares the verified and not-suspended rules and messages with finestro:make-admin. The docs describe the MFA first-enrolment rule, and the stray txt files are gone. Iteration-2 evidence: composer quality exits 0; php artisan test and --order-by=random both give 852 passed / 15 intentional ApiEndpointMatrix skips / 3688 assertions (baseline 672 / 15 / 2734); the PHPStan baseline still has 3 entries; route:list, l5-swagger:generate, view:cache/clear, filament:optimize/clear and npm run build exit 0; migrate --pretend has nothing pending, and the Phase 6 migration is additive. The panel, access rule, MFA, data minimisation, suspension, CSP decision and Phase 5 fixes are unchanged from pass 1 and match plan.md and the brief. One cosmetic, non-blocking note remains.
findings: Non-blocking: AdminPaymentsExport::text() adds the formula-guard apostrophe for XLSX too, where cells are already strings, so the apostrophe likely shows as a literal character. Optionally apply the prefix only for the CSV writer.
